invariants.rationale: Method always constructs and returns a TiledMap instance, so result should be non-null.
fileName is used unconditionally with resolve(fileName), so it must be non-null on any path that returns.
parameter is dereferenced (parameter.textureMinFilter, parameter.textureMagFilter); null would cause NPE before any return.
The atlas is wrapped in an owned resources array for the result.
The method adds the atlas as an owned resource, so this collection should be non-empty at exit.
